metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Lake Sambhar, India decrease in around April 10, 2019 compared to around September 30, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Sambhar, India (approximately 26.9°N, 75.1°E) - Two time periods: around September 30, 2018 and around April 10, 2019 - Use Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection (works through clouds) or JRC Global Surface Water for seasonal water extent - Alternative: Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 with water indices (NDWI/MNDWI) 2. Masking strategy: - For optical data (Sentinel-2/Landsat): Mask clouds using QA bands - For water detection: Use NDWI/MNDWI threshold (>0 typically indicates water) or VH/VV polarization for SAR - Calculate water pixel counts for both periods 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If water extent is legitimately 0 (lake dried up) - this is a valid B answer - C1: No images found in collection for either period - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water extent: If April 2019 < September 2018, answer A (decrease), else B I'll use Sentinel-2 with MNDWI for water detection, with a ±15 day window for each date. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeSambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.1, 26.9]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius const date1Start = '2018-09-15'; const date1End = '2018-10-15'; const date2Start = '2019-03-26'; const date2End = '2019-04-25'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. MNDWI calculation (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // 4. Data Acquisition - September 2018 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addMNDWI); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 2018 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(function(img) { const mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return img.addBands(mndwi); }); const size1_l8 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 2018 Landsat Images: ${size1_l8}`); if (size1_l8 === 0) { console.log("No data for Sept 2018."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 5. Data Acquisition - April 2019 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addMNDWI); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(function(img) { const mndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); return img.addBands(mndwi); }); const size2_l8 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Landsat Images: ${size2_l8}`); if (size2_l8 === 0) { console.log("No data for April 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 6. Create composite and detect water const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); const water1 = img1.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2 = img2.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // 7. Calculate water extent (pixel counts) const stats1 = water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels1 = stats1.get('MNDWI').getInfo(); const waterPixels2 = stats2.get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 2018 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels1}`); console.log(`April 2019 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels2}`); // 8. Validation & Final Answer if (waterPixels1 === null || waterPixels2 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (waterPixels1 === 0 && waterPixels2 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels in either period."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check if water decreased from Sept 2018 to April 2019 if (waterPixels2 < waterPixels1) { console.log("Water extent decreased from Sept 2018 to April 2019."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did not decrease."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
